title: angrr: 0.1.5 -> 0.2.0
reason: Large real refactor: 'period', 'removeRoot', 'ownedOnly' ALL removed via mkRemovedOptionModule (3 real removals, no successors), replaced by a new 'settings'/'configFile' TOML-based submodule with its own nested 'temporary-root-policies.<name>.period' field (a DIFFERENT, unrelated option that happens to share the leaf name 'period').

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: NEW, DISTINCT FINDING -- LEAF-NAME COLLISION MASKS A REAL REMOVAL: raw.json reports this transition as 'unchanged' (PredicateNotFound both sides), which LOOKS like nothing happened. But directly diffing discovered_options confirms the real story: at BASE, a genuine top-level 'services.angrr.period' option exists (bare ['period'] path, PredicateNotFound verdict, real removal target). At HEAD, that top-level option is GONE (real mkRemovedOptionModule removal, confirmed via the diff) -- but a completely unrelated NEW nested option 'settings.temporary-root-policies.<name>.period' now exists deep inside a wildcard attrsOf(submodule), and it ALSO has a bare leaf name 'period'. The watch mechanism's leaf-name match at head silently resolved to THIS unrelated nested option instead of correctly reporting the top-level option as OptionNotFound, producing a false 'unchanged' verdict that completely masks a real, clean option removal. This is a genuinely new gap shape (distinct from mkPackageOption, wildcard attrsOf non-discovery, genAttrs non-discovery, and the rendering gap): a same-leaf-name collision between an unrelated option elsewhere in the same file and the real removed option, which the watch matcher cannot disambiguate. Flagging prominently -- this is a tool-behavior artifact, not a real-world nixpkgs issue, and it is the first confirmed instance of this specific shape.
